Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-cluster/

Cluster router over a built-in sample topology or the nodes of a Kubernetes cluster (kube-rs, feature `kube`): consistent-hash proxy choice, KV-cache prefix affinity and prefill/decode scheduling after Pingora, ai-dynamo and llm-d (none is a dependency)
